versions.changelog:
chromecast-control-free v1.0.0

- Initial release with basic Chromecast device control using the catt tool.
- Supports device discovery, media casting (YouTube, Vimeo, direct URL, local files), playback (play, pause, stop), and volume management (set, increase, decrease, mute).
- Designed for simple home entertainment and casting scenarios on Windows, macOS, and Linux.
- No API key required; outputs results in Markdown with status and error handling.
- Advanced features like seek, queue management, subtitle loading, and device aliasing are only available in the full version.
